name: ZCH_SCORING_MODEL_DETAILS
description: zch_scoring_model_details table stores the conditions and the score weight for the scoring model.

columns.name: MODEL_DETAIL_UUID
columns.description: Sequence generated id to uniquely identify a record

columns.name: GROUP_UUID
columns.description: key to group the list of records in this table into one score

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Name of the object that this scoring detail expression is based on

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the attribute that this scoring detail expression is using

columns.name: OPERATOR
columns.description: Operator name used in this scoring detail

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: First value used by the operator

columns.name: VALUE2
columns.description: Second value used by the operator

columns.name: SCORE_EXPR
columns.description: Score expression that is build by the object name, attribute name, operator and/or values

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
